 Gold and silver prices today, 16 November: Check latest 24K, 22K gold and 999 silver retail rates across Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and other major Indian cities, along with MCX market updates.
 Shivam Shukla Published 16 Nov 2026, 09:38 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Share via Advertisement Gold and silver price today: Check retail rates of 24K, 22K gold and 999 silver. (AI-generated image for representational purposes only) AI Quick Read Gold and silver prices, 16 November: Gold and silver prices edged lower in the domestic market on Monday amid continued uncertainty after fading hopes of a Middle East peace deal fanned inflation fears.
 On the other hand, gold prices edged higher in early Asian trade on Monday after last week's more-than-one-year low, as investors awaited remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh for clues to the outlook for US interest rates.
 Advertisement Spot gold was up 0.3% at $3,892.42 per ounce by 0050 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery rose 0.2% to $3,895.60. Bullion dropped 4.5% last week, pressured by rising oil prices that fuelled inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of higher-for-longer interest rates.
 In the domestic futures market, MCX gold futures were trading 0.81% lower at ₹ 1,36,220 per 10 grams, while MCX silver futures declined by around 3.16% to ₹ 1,71,680 per kg at around 9:13 am.
 Gold is available in different purities in the retail market, with 24-karat gold being the purest form and 22-karat gold commonly used to make jewellery due to its greater durability. Silver 999, also known as 99.9% pure silver, is a high-purity form of silver commonly used for investment purposes, including silver bars and coins.
